notes: I'm not waiting until I start to work on these. For roadmapping, the product director has agreed to mentor me and review my priorities every two weeks, and on day 90 I'll hand in a draft roadmap for the next half-year. For specs, before I start I'll shadow IT's product team through one full sprint, from review to release, and by day 60 I'll deliver my first complete spec. How will you know it worked? On day 90, score me again on today's table, and put the result in my probation review.
